govdocs-archive_org-nsia-KDKA_KDKA: This Westinghouse Broadcasting KDKA Group letterhead — November — is a corporate item. KDKA was a pioneer broadcaster. Letterheads carry the era’s style. The item is a curiosity. The file belongs to the press archive. The item is a fragment of business history.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-alaska: This 1913 reference piece on Alaska — the missions of the frozen north. Joseph Crimont, the missionary bishop, tells the tale. Jesuits braved ice and hunger. Native villages heard the Gospel. The Church at the top of the world. Its dog sleds carried the missionaries.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-banjaluka: This 1913 reference piece on Banjaluka — the Bosnian diocese. Louis Petit tells its border story. Its bishops serve the mixed flock. The Vrbas river guards its town. A see of the Balkan frontier. Its Trappists brew the famous cheese. Its cathedral crowns the river town.
